data.name: Pramendra
data.gender_notes: Pramendra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Pramendra is a compound name derived from the Sanskrit words 'pra' meaning supreme and 'mendra' meaning light or radiance. It represents the supreme source of light and wisdom. The name Pramendra carries the meaning “Supreme Light” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Pramendra usually hope their child will grow to embody supreme light and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Pramendra is a spiritual name signifying the supreme source of light and wisdom in Hinduism. It is believed that the name carries the blessings of various Hindu gods associated with light and wisdom.
data.etymology: Pramendra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Supreme Light.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Pramendra total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
